headline: United States GP: Circuit of the Americas, 23-25 October, race on 25 October
whyCareReason: Formula1.com lists Austin next. Antonelli still leads by 102 points after Singapore. No session has a result.
teaser: Formula1.com's full timetable lists the grand prix at 15:00 local time. This desk does not convert that clock. Status stays upcoming.
story: There is no Grand Prix on 13 October. Formula1.com lists the United States Grand Prix at the Circuit of the Americas for 23-25 October 2026, with the race on 25 October. The full timetable lists the grand prix at 15:00 local time and notes that the timetable can change. This desk does not convert that clock into US Eastern time. The circuit is 5.513 km, with 56 laps and a race distance of 308.405 km. The first grand prix there was in 2012. After Singapore, Kimi Antonelli has 340 points and George Russell 238, a gap of 102. Mercedes have 578 constructor points and Ferrari 444. McLaren's 339 is the team total. No Austin session has a result.
stakes: The lead is 102 points with Austin, Mexico, Brazil, Las Vegas, Qatar and Abu Dhabi still to run. Nothing in Texas has been timed yet.
rivalryAngle: The championship does not move on a Tuesday. The next chance to move it is Austin.
